info.name: Get native balance for a single address

params.name: module
params.description: API module name (account, block, contract, logs, token, stats, transaction, proxy).

params.name: action
params.description: API action within the module.

params.name: address
params.description: Ethereum-compatible wallet or contract address (0x-prefixed, 42 chars).

params.name: tag
params.description: Pre-defined block parameter for balance queries.

params.name: apikey
params.description: API key for authenticated access. Use "placeholder" for free tier.

items.docs: Returns the native token (AVAX, ETH, etc.) balance of a given address at the latest block.

info.name: Get native balance for multiple addresses

params.description: Pre-defined block parameter for balance queries.

params.name: apikey
params.description: API key for authenticated access. Use "placeholder" for free tier.

items.docs: Returns the native token balance for up to 20 addresses in a single call. Pass addresses as a comma-separated list.

params.name: address
params.description: Ethereum-compatible wallet or contract address (0x-prefixed, 42 chars).

params.description: Starting block number for block-range queries.

params.description: Ending block number for block-range queries.

params.name: page
params.description: Page number for paginated results.

params.name: offset
params.description: Number of results per page (max 10000).

params.name: sort
params.description: Sort order for results (ascending or descending).

params.description: API key for authenticated access. Use "placeholder" for free tier.

items.docs: Returns a list of normal (external) transactions performed by an address. Supports block range filtering and pagination.
